AGENDA

OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

1.

Draft Action Minutes
2.
Approval of the 2016-2018 Budget and Capital Plan and Adoption of Resolution R16-19 Establishing the FY16/17 Appropriations Limit and Resolution R16-20 Adopting the Fiscal Year 2016/17 Annual Budget Setting the Limitation of Expenditures; and Approval of Resolutions R16-21, R16-22, and R16-23 Setting Forth Policies and Procedures with Reference to the Classification and Compensation for Management-Administration, Professional & Supervisory, and Sworn Police Management Employee Groups
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve and adopt the 2016-2018 Biennial Budget and Capital Plan, along with Resolution R16-20 adopting year-one, Fiscal Year 2016-2017, adopt Resolution R16-19 establishing the Fiscal Year 2016-2017 Appropriations Limit, and Resolutions R16-21, R16-22 and R16-23 setting forth policies and procedures with reference to the classification and compensation for Management-Administration, Professional & Supervisory, and Sworn Police Management employee groups.
Staff Report
3.
PW-637-16; Award of Construction Contract for FY 16/17 Fire Safety & Weed Abatement Services and Adoption of Resolution R16-24 Adjusting the FY16/17 Budget
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council award a construction contract for the award of FY16/17 Fire Safety & Weed Abatement Services in the amount of $ 169,311 to Venco Western, Inc. and approve the FY 16/17 General Operating Budget Adjustment to allow for $19,311 per Resolution R16-24 for a total project cost of $169,311.
Staff Report
4.
Extension of City Hall/Police Department Janitorial Services Agreement with All Care Industries
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve a two-year extension of the agreement with All Care Industries, Inc. to provide City Hall/Police Department janitorial services at a cost of $2,248/month during FY 16/17 with a 5% increase for FY 17/18 and authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to extend the agreement.
Staff Report
5.
Approval of Two-Year Agreement with McGowan Consulting LLC for LA MS4 Stormwater Related Compliance Consulting Services
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve an agreement with McGowan Consulting, LLC in the amount of $153,750 for LA MS4 Permit compliance services.
Staff Report
6.
Amendment No. 1 to FY15/16 and FY16/17 Agreement for Landscape Maintenance of Parks, Paths, Medians, Open Space Parklands and Rights-of-Way FY15/16 and FY16/17 with Venco Western, Inc.
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the annual contract amount of the agreement with Venco Western, Inc. to $250,000 annually and authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the agreement to increase the compensation amounts.
Staff Report
7.
Police Department Duty Weapons Replacement Purchase
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the weapons replacement purchase with LC Action in the amount of $48,051.51.
Staff Report
8.
Opposition to AB 2788 (Gatto) â€“Wireless Telecommunication Facilities
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council express its opposition to AB 2788, affirming the letter sent to legislators, and authorize further communications as necessary on this item.
